subject: Contract renewal: EU activation + APAC pilot & cross-region failover
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Anna Klein <anna.klein@theracore.com>, Luke Owens <luke.owens@theracore.com>
Cc: procurement@theracore.com
Date: Tue, 05 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Contract renewal: EU activation + APAC pilot & cross-region failover

Hi Anna / Luke,

As we approach your September renewal I wanted to outline a proposal that covers three items you asked about on our last call: EU data residency (primary), an APAC pilot (standby/burst), and a small capacity uplift to support an expanded feature set in Q4.

High level proposal: 
- Term: 12 months, with option to extend to 24 months at fixed pricing.
- EU Activation: Add a dedicated EU node (Frankfurt) with EU-only data routing and logs retention policy. Includes SOC 2 evidence and an audit window.
- APAC Pilot: Staged pilot capacity in APAC (Singapore) configured as hot-standby for failover and burst. 100 reserved GPU-hrs/mo during pilot, with on-demand scaling to handle spikes.
- Upsell: Increase token capacity by +30% for the Q4 uplift; waived overage for first two months during cutover.

I attached a brief MAP draft for review (TheraCore-MAP_v3_draft.pdf). Can we set a 30-minute sync next week to walk the SOW boundaries and procurement timings? Suggested times: Wed 5/6 10–11am PT or Thu 5/7 8–10am PT.

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm acceptance of EU + APAC scoping.
2) I’ll loop in Priya for pricing and Monica for the ops runbook.
3) Procurement can review the SOW/Docusign link once the scope is locked.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0147

Attachment: ThermoCore-MAP_v3_draft.pdf (1.2MB)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 05 May 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract renewal: EU activation + APAC pilot & cross-region failover (internal)

Marcus — quick internal note before the call:
- Pricing: EU node is +15% on top of current committed rate (includes KMS integration and audit retention). APAC pilot as hot-standby should be priced as a reserved bucket (we recommend 100 GPU-hrs/mo at pilot rate, with a predefined overage ceiling).
- Upsell: +30% token capacity can be structured as a monthly add-on SKU; first two months free during cutover as you suggested.
- Procurement will likely push for a 12-month term with an automatic 30-day renewal window; if they want 24 months we can offer a 5% discount.

I’ll prepare a redlined pricing sheet for Priya to include in the SOW.

—Ben
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
From: Anna Klein <anna.klein@theracore.com>

Subject: Re: Contract renewal: EU activation + APAC pilot & cross-region failover

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the clear summary. We want to proceed to a scoped SOW that covers:
1) EU primary residency (Frankfurt) with SC-2/SOC2 evidence and attestations around log storage.
2) APAC pilot as standby — goal is regional latency improvement for APAC users and a tested failover path.
3) Pricing clarity for the +30% capacity uplift and an agreeable commercial path post-pilot.

Two asks before our sync: 
- Can you send a short doc (1–2 pages) describing the EU residency controls and the expected audit timeline?
- For the APAC pilot, we need a list of integration constraints (VPC peering, IP ranges, expected RTO). Luke and I are available Thu 5/7 17:00 CET (8:00 PT) for the call.

On the procurement side, procurement@theracore.com will want to see the SOW and a cost table before we route to legal.

Appreciate it — Anna
Anna Klein
Director of Infrastructure | TheraCore, Inc.
anna.klein@theracore.com
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Anna Klein <anna.klein@theracore.com>, Luke Owens <luke.owens@theracore.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 07 May 2026 07:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract renewal: EU activation + APAC pilot & cross-region failover (technical note)

Hi Anna / Luke — quick technical note ahead of the call: 
- EU Node (Frankfurt): we provision a dedicated cluster behind a customer-dedicated routing tag. Data-at-rest is encrypted with customer-managed keys (KMS). Audit logs are retained for 13 months by default (can extend).
- APAC Pilot (Singapore): configured as hot-standby with async replication of model weights and periodic KV-prefix sync for active user sessions. Expected median latency improvement: ~40–70ms for APAC endpoints.
- Failover: We provide automated health-check-based failover with manual confirmation for stateful workloads. Recovery Time Objective (RTO) target for session-resumed workloads: 3–7 minutes depending on model size and KV state.
- Integration constraints: requires VPC peering plus an allowlist of our egress IPs (I’ll share the list). No inbound VPN required for the pilot; we can add VPN for production if desired.

Attached: apac-pilot-architecture.png and a short checklist. Happy to walk through on Thu 8:00 PT.

—Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
